entries.title: Open question: B-1048 — protecting the plugin's intellectual property: the repo is public MIT by early accident and ships its whole source; prose cannot be kept secret, so the
entries.content:
**Claim:** Theme B-1048 is proposed as an unresolved question, subject to review.

**Claim source:** derived

Not yet decided. Proposed from milestone “Big Future Themes”; this is not evidence of shipped behaviour.

- B-1048 — protecting the plugin's intellectual property: the repo is public MIT by early accident and ships its whole source; prose cannot be kept secret, so the levers are the licence for future versions (all copyright is ycomplex's), shipping only what runs on the served branches, private-repo or signed-archive distribution, a conductor split (with B-999), and a thin client over a Harmony-hosted MCP server (with B-938). Cheap steps first; the visibility decision before the first external tenant. Not legal advice. Paper: 2026-09-18-protecting-plugin-ip-options.md.

entries.title: Open question: B-999 — the conductor host as a real service with a face: `harmony daemon install | start | stop | restart | status | logs | doctor` generating launchd/systemd
entries.content:
**Claim:** Theme B-999 is proposed as an unresolved question, subject to review.

**Claim source:** derived

Not yet decided. Proposed from milestone “Big Future Themes”; this is not evidence of shipped behaviour.

- B-999 — the conductor host as a real service with a face: `harmony daemon install | start | stop | restart | status | logs | doctor` generating launchd/systemd from the deployment config (no token in a plist), a per-daemon heartbeat row (identity, version, profile, preflight, slots) plus worker liveness in the database so the web and iOS views are the face for every daemon wherever it runs, then a Mac menubar shell as a macOS target of the operator app. A Mac app as the architecture was rejected. Depends on B-971 (identity, per-conduction profile select) and on B-939 + B-947 (v1.5). Paper: 2026-09-10-conductor-host-service-posture-and-face-options.md.
